title: You're Not Afraid of Failing — You're Afraid of Being Seen 😶 | Start Scared
description:
You're not afraid of failing. You're afraid of being seen failing. Of the laugh. Of the "I told you so."

But here's the truth: most people are too busy to notice — and the ones who laugh aren't doing anything themselves.

A year from now, you'll wish you started today. Bad first attempts are the price of good ones.

So start ugly. Start scared. Just start.

🔔 Subscribe if you sometimes need a push forward.

#motivation #fearoffailure #mindset #justStart #selfimprovement #motivationalvideo #personalgrowth #courage
